name: Madlein
beschreibung: Hotel Madlein is centrally located in the Tiroler ski resort of Ischgl, in the immediate vicinity of the mountain railway. The architecture of the house combines alpine elements with contemporary design. The wellness area offers an indoor pool, an outdoor pool, and various saunas and steam baths. The culinary offering includes a restaurant with Tiroler cuisine and a gourmet restaurant. The target group is guests seeking comfortable accommodation with an upscale standard. In addition, a fitness room and conference facilities are available.
